notes.title: Update Released - Version 2.1.0
notes.content:
We have released an update which fixes several bugs and improves the graphic quality of VTree Beach Volleyball.

What's new in this update:

- [Improved] Increased texture resolution for many scenery objects.

- [Fixed] Erratic movement of a player when completing a jumping serve.

- [Fixed] Character would slide sideways when changing court

- [Fixed] Shadow casters were not working correctly with characters.
